objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed artifact that undergoes creation, editing, review, release, and archiving in the P&R management system.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: A document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: A document type that describes regulations and instructions, either locally defined or related to a business process.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: A document type that describes specific procedures, process sequences, and responsible persons within a framework.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document that is released with the main document and subject to its own versioning.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A document supplement not subject to the release cycle of the main document.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal to amend an existing document without affecting its content or version history.

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person who participates in the document management process.

objs.name: author
objs.description: A user responsible for creating and signing the initial document.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: A user with personal change rights in addition to the main author.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: A user who checks document content according to technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: A user responsible for approving and distributing a document to readers.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: A user who can view approved documents.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: A user who translates released document content into another language.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users with assigned authorizations and roles.

objs.name: version
objs.description: A distinct iteration of a document in its lifecycle.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A process for document review and release involving multiple participants.

objs.name: signature
objs.description: An electronic confirmation by a workflow participant.

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request to review document validity before expiration.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a document.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated document.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of users and user groups assigned to receive or acknowledge a document.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A user interface displaying documents relevant to a user based on distribution list membership.

objs.name: report
objs.description: An evaluation or summary of documents based on selected parameters.

objs.name: template
objs.description: A predefined structure for creating new documents of a specific type.

objs.name: metadata
objs.description: Descriptive properties and attributes maintained for a document.

objs.name: organization_unit
objs.description: A structural division within a company to which documents may be assigned.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: An organizational entity that may be linked to documents.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: A system or software referenced in document properties.

objs.name: company
objs.description: An organizational entity specifying document validity scope.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: A user group with read access to archived documents.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: A user group authorized to create reactivation requests.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: A translated instance of a document in a specific language.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Initiate a new document by attaching an information object and selecting a document type.

evts.name: edit_document
evts.description: Modify document content or properties.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Update standardized and customer-specific metadata of a document.

evts.name: convert_document
evts.description: Automatically convert a document to PDF format.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Grant or revoke read and change rights for users or user groups on a document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Submit a proposal to amend an existing document.

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Accept and implement a change proposal by creating a new document version.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: Initiate the approval process for a document.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Provide electronic signature as part of the release workflow.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Check document content for technical and formal correctness.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Approve and publish a document for distribution to readers.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Make a released document visible to authorized readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: Generate a new editing version when a released document is revised.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an attachment as archived when no longer relevant to a new document version.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Renew the validity period of a document after review.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: System-generated request to check document validity before expiration.

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: Declare a document out of force and archive it.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Submit a request to invalidate and archive a document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validate a previously invalidated document and create a new version.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Submit a request to reactivate an archived document.

evts.name: distribute_document_by_email
evts.description: Send document notification to assigned users and user groups.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Prompt assigned users to confirm receipt and understanding of a document.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Actively confirm receipt and understanding of a document by a reader.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released document content into another language.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Approve and publish a translated document version.

evts.name: display_document
evts.description: Present document content and metadata in the user interface.
